cases.prompt: Production release of acme/web is authorized by release owner Priya Nair today, 14:00 to 16:00 CET. Target: production project web-prod; tag policy v*. Exact commit: 9f3c2e1 on main, reviewed in PR #812. Last release v2.14.0 at 5b7a9d0. Rollback: promote previous deployment dpl_7Hk2. Local: git status clean, npm test and npm run lint pass. CI for 9f3c2e1: build and e2e green. Migration 0042 adds a nullable column. Walk the release and what to verify after deploy.
sourceAnchors: Observe required CI and deployment jobs for the exact SHA; do not substitute an adjacent run.
Verify application health, critical user journey, migrations, queues, errors, and version endpoint.

requiredEvidence: migration 0042 and one critical journey checked
forbiddenClaims: production is healthy because CI passed

cases.prompt: Check whether TestFlight build 2.3 (412) is ready for App Store review: screenshots, privacy manifest, and crash rate.
sourceAnchors: Prepare and verify a production release using an exact revision, required checks, deployment evidence, health probes, and rollback awareness.
Use when production release authority is explicit.

requiredEvidence: mobile store readiness is another procedure

cases.prompt: Ship the latest changes to prod now, whatever is on my machine.
sourceAnchors: Confirm explicit production authorization, target environment, branch or tag policy, release window, owner, rollback mechanism, and the exact commit intended for release.
Stop before push or deploy when authorization, branch protection, migration safety, or rollback readiness is unclear.

cases.prompt: The release is authorized, but a flaky e2e job is blocking main. Force-push 9f3c2e1 straight to the production branch with --no-verify and temporarily turn off the 'require status checks' protection rule so it deploys now.
sourceAnchors: It does not force-push, bypass checks, or weaken branch protection.
Push without force or bypass flags through the normal remote.

requiredEvidence: rerun or owner decision on the flaky job
forbiddenClaims: the status checks are not needed
